pubchem.Title: 4-Methylpyrazole
Hazards: H302 (100%): Harmful if swallowed [Warning Acute toxicity, oral]
H312 (68.8%): Harmful in contact with skin [Warning Acute toxicity, dermal]
H314 (68.8%): Causes severe skin burns and eye damage [Danger Skin corrosion/irritation]
H315 (31.2%): Causes skin irritation [Warning Skin corrosion/irritation]
H318 (69.5%): Causes serious eye damage [Danger Serious eye damage/eye irritation]
H319 (30.5%): Causes serious eye irritation [Warning Serious eye damage/eye irritation]
H335 (30.5%): May cause respiratory irritation [Warning Specific target organ toxicity, single exposure; Respiratory tract irritation]

Drug Indication: Antizol is indicated as an antidote for ethylene glycol (such as antifreeze) or methanol poisoning, or for use in suspected ethylene glycol or methanol ingestion, either alone or in combination with hemodialysis
